title: VendeeView
description: What the navigation screen shows. Exactly these fields.

next_waypoint.description: The waypoint being sailed to. Starts at Finisterre; moves on when the boat is within 10 nm of it.

to_next_nm.description: Great-circle distance from the boat to the next waypoint, nautical miles (1852 m). null before the first fix.

to_finish_nm.description: to_next_nm plus the great-circle legs from the next waypoint through each later waypoint in order to the Finish, nautical miles. null before the first fix.

run_24h_nm.description: Distance sailed along the track over the last 24 hours (since the first fix if that is less than 24 hours ago), nautical miles. 0 before any.

vmg_kn.description: Velocity made good towards the next waypoint, knots: GPS speed times the cosine of the angle between the GPS course and the bearing to the waypoint. Negative when sailing away. null until there is a fix and a velocity.
